name: kettlebell clean and press
description: Clean two kettlebells from the floor or backswing into a double rack, then press both overhead.
instructions: Stand over two kettlebells, take one handle in each hand, and hinge at the hips.
Drive through your legs and hips to bring both bells close to your body into the rack position.
Brace your trunk and press both bells overhead without leaning back.
Lower them to the rack, then carefully return them to the floor or backswing to repeat.
